description: Land Reform Commission - Order of the Walahandoowawattha Conveyed back to Land Reform Commission
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the revocation of land vested in the Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation and its conveyance back to the Land Reform Commission. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their locations, extents, and title references, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
